prompt:
Use case: compositing / UI layout edit.
Edit the supplied RUSHITADEL title concept into ONE new CENTERED main-menu screen, same landscape aspect ratio.
MANDATORY LAYOUT CHANGE: abolish the left-menu/right-preview split entirely. Logo and all four buttons are centered on the exact SCREEN horizontal centerline, x=50%. Logo at upper-center, four equal-width buttons stacked beneath, compact centered group with generous spacing. Central calm near-black navy region occupies roughly 42% of width. No right preview frame, minimap, scanner HUD or tiny technical labels.
Retain the reference's restrained dark navy and pale mint tactical pixel-art identity but SIMPLIFY it into a casual-classic menu. Logo text exactly "RUSHITADEL": clean bold PIXEL block letters, solid pale mint, no distress/cracks/stone texture, no fancy emblem crossing letters. All Korean text and icons MUST be crisp PIXEL typography, NOT smooth vector sans-serif. Buttons exactly "게임 시작", "이어하기", "설정", "게임 종료"; clean 1-2 pixel rectangular outlines, square or stepped corners, very small pixel icons, no bevel/rivets/ornate brackets. Start flat mint filled with dark text and small pixel triangle; continue visibly dim; settings and quit navy with pale mint text. No extra words.
Side decoration: LEFT and RIGHT outer thirds form a sparse, simple top-down pixel landscape framing the center. A raised grassy/mossy cliff plateau on left, with a small understated patch of deep blue water near bottom-left. A raised icy stone plateau on right with a SMALL restrained magma crack near bottom-right, optionally a tiny yellow electric pixel accent, not spectacular lightning. Sparse large pixel clusters, matte limited-palette tiles, only a few rocks/grass tufts; do not fill every space with detailed foliage. Side environments should be subdued supporting decoration, not competing illustrations. Both plateau faces visibly descend inward toward the lower dark CENTRAL ROAD behind menu. TWO small red-core robot enemies on each raised plateau, clearly standing atop ground, aiming inward. No enemies on center road. One small gray-violet circular player with EXACTLY FIVE short radial turrets on central road at bottom center BELOW the last button, not overlapping UI. No combat particles or trajectory lines crossing menu.
Preserve recognizability of robots and pixel game theme, but every element (text, border, sprites, terrain) has consistent hard square-pixel edges and limited shade ramps. Pixel look end-to-end, not painterly, blurry, glossy 3D or modern mobile UI. Reduced visual noise, balanced sides, uncluttered readable center. Logo and buttons MUST be at true screen center, no sidebar layout. No outer thick frame or watermark.
